correctness.rationale: For σ with cycle counts m_e on n≥1 labels, a commuting total map sends each e-cycle to a single d-cycle with d|e and exactly d phases. Idempotence forces every image point fixed, hence the image is a selection of complete σ-cycles and each unselected e-cycle maps independently into a selected divisor cycle. This gives Σ_{k}z^{Σ d k_d}∏_e binom(m_e,k_e)(Σ_{d|e}d k_d)^{m_e−k_e}, with 0^0=1. Every supported divisibility-minimal length must select ≥1 cycle; one each suffices, proving Rmin=Σ_{d∈M} d and exact min-rank multiplicity by independent phase counts. Burnside on S_n conjugacy classes of rooted-fiber idempotents yields 1/n! Σ_σFσ(z)=Σ_{λ⊢n}z^{ℓ(λ)}. Independently enumerated every map on 4 labels for σ cycle profiles (4),(2,2),(3,1),(1,1,1,1), checking entire rank polynomials (e.g. identity: 4z+24z²+12z³+z⁴). Full source verifier checked as algorithm, its claimed n≤8 runs are bounded and not the all-n proof.
